images.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: measured modeling reference sheet for a realistic first-person Korean horror game prop. Input image 1 is the authentic manufacturer close-up of a piano tuning lever star socket; image 2 is the authentic complete lever. Use both strictly as physical reference, not as an edit target. Produce one clean photographic modeling sheet of this SAME ordinary piano tuning lever with four separate consistent views: full side elevation, full front elevation, full back elevation, and enlarged open star socket end. Plain neutral gray background, parallel projections, no perspective exaggeration, soft neutral lighting, no dramatic shadows. A 30.5cm total tool with a gently curved turned hardwood handle about 16.5cm long, warm worn medium brown longitudinal fine wood grain, rounded butt, nickel ferrule and continuous nickel-plated steel shaft entering the handle. Short bent end and round hollow socket with an eight-point star recess, as the real photographs show. The head is physically connected to the shaft. Only restrained everyday wear; no fantasy details, no hammer striking head, no rubber grip, no branding, no lettering, no dimensions, no arrows. All four views must describe exactly the same physical object.
images.usage: 실물 사진과 함께 조율 렌치의 비율과 연결 구조를 확인하는 모델링 참고도. 게임 화면이 아님.

images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: grayscale opacity mask for a hand-pressure residue decal on the concealed plaster wall of a Korean horror game. Reference image is a real photograph of dirty hands pressing a wall; refer to its broken palm contact, blank palm centers, unequal finger-pad contacts and smearing, not its photograph or background. Generate ONLY a flat black-and-white texture: two incomplete adult hand impressions in dusty residue, white and gray residue on a perfectly solid pure black background. One partial palm and four uneven fingertip contacts slightly above and to the left of center, rotated about 12 degrees, with faint short downward finger smears; one fainter palm fragment lower right, at a different angle, partly overlapping. Human scale realistic five fingers where discernible. The prints must look accidental, dry, patchy, porous, worn, with natural gaps and narrow creases; no complete filled hand silhouettes and no repeated stamp motif. Most pixels remain pure black. Keep every mark well within a broad 15 percent pure black border on every edge. No wall texture, no paper, no labels, no grids, no lines, no frame, no shading, no bevel, no blood, no lighting. Square image.
images.usage: 가벽에 남은 손바닥 접촉 흔적의 마스크. 원본 사진은 배포하지 않음.
